Today on the Matt Walsh Show, the Left's campaign to create a new George Floyd moment has fizzled out and failed. New video and other evidence proves beyond any doubt that the ICE shooting in Minneapolis could not have been any more justified. Also, the chief of police in Portland breaks down in tears on camera for the most embarrassing reason imaginable. Not that there could be a valid reason. And a former conservative influencer has come out, suddenly, as pro-trans. How did this transformation happen, and why?
